style: Acoustic folk dance-band and theatrical cabaret staging, 1960s mono room capture with bleed, upright bass, brushed percussion, honky-tonk piano, acoustic violin, accordion, and massed vocal shouts. Harmony: functional major-minor interrupted by non-diatonic chromatic clusters and modal drone fields. Melody: chromatic cabaret patter that suddenly opens into wide sustained yodel register flips and ornamental folk turns. Rhythm: waltz pulse invaded by heavy duple accents and abrupt metric compression. Timbre: dry close-miked wood, squeaking chair springs, vibrating room air, nasal drone singing, and bright brass stabs. Performance: theatrical overstatement played with breathless tabloid urgency, deadpan news delivery, and hysterical eyewitness panic. Operators: hold the waltz drone fixed while accelerating the vocal patter; compress the acoustic air; make the violin behave like a radio-wave carrier signal without losing its horsehair scratch.
lyrics:
[SCENE START: SATURN HIGH-ORBIT NEWSROOM]
[ANCHOR SETUP: ALARMING TEASER IN FULL VOICE]
[MUSIC START: ACCORDION AND BRUSHED PERCUSSION WALTZ]
[MALE ANCHOR SPOKEN, DRY AND RAPID]
Tonight at eleven! We are receiving urgent electromagnetic telemetry from the inner ring-systems of Saturn! All local subspace relays are buzzing with catastrophic red alerts!
Sensors confirm the unthinkable: our entire reality, every star system, every glowing nebula, and every sentient thought has been officially misclassified as a minor municipal parking violation!
[SINGING, HIGH NASAL TENOR PATTER]
Look at the streaming data beams!
Look at the frost upon the beam!
The ring-country is towing a ticket!
The storm-lords are paying a heavy fine!
[ORCHESTRAL STAB]
[FIELD REPORT: TABLOID REPORTER INTERVIEWING A GAS-GIANT DOCKWORKER]
[FEMALE REPORTER, BREATHLESS, SHOUTING OVER ATMOSPHERIC STATIC]
Sir! Sir! You have been living inside a black hole singularity disguised as an administrative desk drawer for four hundred local cycles! How does this affect your mortgage and your daily coffee rations?
[DOCKWORKER, HOARSE SHOUTING OVER FIDDLE AND HONKY-TONK PIANO]
I thought the crushing gravitational pressure was just normal union rules! I thought the extreme time dilation was just standard corporate efficiency!
Nobody told me the event horizon had an exorbitant late fee attached to its rotational axis!
[CHORUS, MASSSED CHOIR WITH CLOSE-POSITION HARMONY AND YODEL REGISTERS]
Oh, holographic universe, where did you park the celestial car?
The gravitational gradient is writing a parking ticket that stretches so far!
We thought we were stardust shining brightly on the rings of the gas king,
But we are just unpaid debt trapped forever in a bureaucratic spring!
[TRANSITION: FAST WALTZ COLLAPSING INTO A DRONE FIELD]
[SOUND EFFECT: ELECTROMAGNETIC CARRIER INTERFERENCE]
[EXPERT SPECULATION: THE TRANSMISSION IS BREAKING UP]
[ANCHOR SPOKEN, URGENT AND DISTORTED]
We interrupt this broadcast for a terrifying new detail straight from the legal department!
The black hole singularity is actually a dusty filing cabinet located in a damp subterranean municipal basement!
All radio-wave entities are legally classified as overdue library books that must be returned immediately!
[SINGING, THEATRICAL RECITATIVE WITH RAPID SCAT SYLLABLES]
Tic-toc, file the dock!
Read the spine, cross the line!
Signal loss! Signal gain!
We are text in a cabinet rain!
[WALTZ TEMPO DOUBLES INTO HYPER-DRIVE OVERLOAD]
[STRING SCRATCH AND ACCORDION BELLOWS TEAR]
[WITNESS QUOTE: SQUEALING VOICE OVER RUNAWAY PERCUSSION]
My radio carrier frequency has just been officially impounded by the authorities!
The tow truck is an enormous accretion disk pulling us past the event horizon!
They are hauling my entire wavelength straight to the municipal impound lot at light speed!
[VIOLIN SCREECH AS CARRIER FREQUENCY COLLAPSES]
[DRAMATIC REENACTMENT: THE AUDIENCE IS DIRECTLY ADDRESSED]
[CHOIR, WHISPERED RHYTHM UNDER FULL-VOICE NARRATION]
Imagine your entire electromagnetic embodiment...
Being towed by a municipal crane made of cold dark matter...
Across the magnificent rings of Saturn...
Because you completely forgot to feed the cosmic meter before the shift ended!
[CLIMAX: MAXIMUM KINETIC VELOCITY AND BRASS OVERLOAD]
[CHORUS, MASSIVE ENSEMBLE SHOUT AND FAST YODEL FLIPS]
Pay the fine! Pay the fine!
Cross the event horizon line!
Your gravity is overdue!
The towing fee is eating you!
[OUTRO SYSTEM OVERLOAD AND TICKETING AUDIT COMPLETE]
caption: A frantic tabloid news special broadcast from orbit around Saturn, where radio-wave entities discover their reality is a misclassified parking violation. Driven by acoustic folk-cabaret instruments, waltz-to-duple meter collisions, and manic theatrical delivery.
